description: This file contains the implementation of the ProductAvailabilityService, a service class that manages CRUD operations for ProductAvailability entities within a sales management system. It includes dependency injection, and methods to save or update product availability data.

classes.name: ProductAvailabilityServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for managing ProductAvailability entities, providing save or update functionality, extending generic service implementation.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a ProductAvailability entity based on whether the entity's id is null or greater than zero.
